digo_source: Mgombato ('manga cassava'; 'chisamfu / mpeya cassava leaves'; 'makopa dried cassava'; 'jora / bada cassava meal'); Pakia ('Manga')

teaser.en: Digo farmers know about twenty kinds of cassava by name, some sweet, some bitter, each with its own place in the kitchen.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo wanazijua kwa majina takriban aina ishirini za muhogo, nyingine tamu, nyingine chungu, kila moja na nafasi yake jikoni.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anamanya aina phephi makumi mairi za manga kpwa madzina, zanjina za mtswano, zanjina za utsungu, chila aina na nafasiye jikoni.

summary.en: *Manga* is cassava, the second staple of the Digo coast after rice. Its roots are boiled, fried, dried and ground, and its leaves are cooked as greens.
summary.sw: *Manga* ni muhogo, chakula kikuu cha pili cha pwani ya Wadigo baada ya wali. Mizizi yake huchemshwa, hukaangwa, hukaushwa na kusagwa, na majani yake hupikwa kama mboga za majani.
summary.dg: *Manga* ni chakurya cha phiri cha musingi cha pwani ya Adigo bada ya mtele. Mizige nkutserusiwa, nkukalangwa, nkuumiswa na nkusagwa, na makodzage nkujitwa dza mtsunga.

about.en:
*Manga* is a woody shrub with long, knobbly stems and leaves divided like an open hand into five to seven narrow lobes. It is grown for its swollen, starchy roots, which are brown-skinned and white inside.

Digo farmers recognise about twenty cultivars, among them *boriti*, *chibandameno* (sweet), *chileso* (bitter), *guzo*, *gushe* and *mjiriama*. Sweet kinds can be cooked directly, while bitter kinds need more processing to remove their natural toxins.
about.sw:
*Manga* ni kichaka chenye shina gumu kama la mti, chenye mashina marefu yenye vifundo na majani yaliyogawanyika kama kiganja kilichokunjuliwa kuwa sehemu nyembamba tano hadi saba. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya mizizi yake iliyovimba yenye wanga, yenye ganda la kahawia na nyeupe ndani.

Wakulima Wadigo wanatambua takriban aina ishirini, miongoni mwake *boriti*, *chibandameno* (tamu), *chileso* (chungu), *guzo*, *gushe* na *mjiriama*. Aina tamu zinaweza kupikwa moja kwa moja, huku aina chungu zikihitaji usindikaji zaidi ili kuondoa sumu zake za asili.
about.dg:
*Manga* ni chitsaka cha nyama za muhi chenye mihi mire yenye vinundu na makodza ganagoganyika dza mkpwono uriovuguka kpwa vyala tsano hadi sabaa vyembamba. Nkuphandwa kpwa sababu ya mizige iriyovwimba yenye wanga, ambayo ni ya rangi ya dongo kondze na nyereru ndani.

Akurima a Chidigo anamanya aina phephi makumi mairi, kahi yao *boriti*, *chibandameno* (ya mtswano), *chileso* (ya utsungu), *guzo*, *gushe* na *mjiriama*. Aina za mtswano zinaweza kujitwa vivyo, ela aina za utsungu zinahitaji kutengezwa zaidi ili kuusa sumu yao ya chiasili.

where.en: Cassava is grown on sandy farms across Kwale, often intercropped with maize and cowpeas. It tolerates poor soil and drought better than most crops, which makes it a reliable food in hard years.
where.sw: Muhogo hulimwa katika mashamba ya mchanga kote Kwale, mara nyingi ukichanganywa na mahindi na kunde. Huvumilia udongo duni na ukame kuliko mazao mengi, jambo linaloufanya kuwa chakula cha kutegemewa katika miaka migumu.
where.dg: Manga ganaphandwa kpwa minda ya mtsanga kosi Kwale, kpwa kawaida phamwenga na pemba na kunde. Ganavumirira tsi isiyo nono na ukame kuriko mimea minji, na hipho kunagahenda gakale chakurya cha kuluphirika kpwa miaka ya shida.

uses.en:
The roots are boiled, fried or cooked in coconut milk. They are also peeled and sun-dried as *makopa*, which keep well and are pounded into flour for *jora* or *bada*, a stiff porridge.

The leaves, called *chisamfu* or *mpeya*, are pounded and cooked as a vegetable.
uses.sw:
Mizizi huchemshwa, hukaangwa au hupikwa kwa tui la nazi. Pia humenywa na kukaushwa juani kuwa *makopa*, ambayo hukaa muda mrefu bila kuharibika na hutwangwa kuwa unga wa *jora* au *bada*, ugali mzito.

Majani, yanayoitwa *chisamfu* au *mpeya*, hutwangwa na kupikwa kama mboga.
uses.dg:
Mizi nkutserusiwa, nkukalangwa au nkujitwa kpwa huwi. Piya nkuguwiwa na kuanikpwa dzuwani ikakala *makopa*, ambago ganakaa muda mrefu na nkuphondwa kuhenda unga wa *jora* au *bada*, sima ngumu.

Makodza, ganagoihwa *chisamfu* au *mpeya*, nkuphondwa na kujitwa dza mtsunga.

culture.en: The Digo language has a rich vocabulary for cassava: *gbwindi* is a big tuber, *gbwazo* and *mwachupa* are varieties, and *maugu* are the nodules on the stem. Cassava came to Africa from South America, but on the coast it has become fully at home.
culture.sw: Lugha ya Kidigo ina msamiati mpana wa muhogo: *gbwindi* ni kiazi kikubwa, *gbwazo* na *mwachupa* ni aina, na *maugu* ni vifundo vilivyo kwenye shina. Muhogo ulikuja Afrika kutoka Amerika Kusini, lakini pwani umezoeleka kabisa kama mmea wa nyumbani.
culture.dg: Luga ya Chidigo ina maneno manji ga manga: *gbwindi* ni manga kulu, *gbwazo* na *mwachupa* ni aina, na *maugu* ni vinundu vya muhi. Manga gakarehwa Afrika kula Amerika ya Kusini, ela pwani gakakala chitu cha hipha kabisa.

names.en: Digo: *manga* for the plant and root, *chisamfu* or *mpeya* for the leaves, and *makopa* for the dried pieces. Swahili: *muhogo*; the leaves are *kisamvu* in Tanzanian Swahili. English: cassava. Scientists call it *Manihot esculenta*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *manga* kwa mmea na mzizi, *chisamfu* au *mpeya* kwa majani, na *makopa* kwa vipande vilivyokaushwa. Kiswahili: *muhogo*; majani ni *kisamvu* katika Kiswahili cha Tanzania. Kiingereza: *cassava*. Wanasayansi huuita *Manihot esculenta*.
names.dg: Chidigo: *manga* kpwa mmea na mizi, *chisamfu* au *mpeya* kpwa makodza, na *makopa* kpwa vipande vikavu. Chiswahili: *muhogo*; makodza ni *kisamvu* kpwa Chiswahili cha Tanzania. Kpwa Chingereza ganaihwa *cassava*. Asayansi anagaiha *Manihot esculenta*.

reason.en: Maize, grown in the same fields and ground for ugali
reason.sw: Mahindi, yanayolimwa katika mashamba hayohayo na kusagwa kwa ajili ya ugali
reason.dg: Pemba, inayophandwa kpwa minda iyo iyo na kusagwa kpwa sima

reason.sw: Kunde, zao la kawaida la kuchanganywa shambani
reason.dg: Kunde, mmea unaophandwa phamwenga na manga kpwa kawaida

reason.sw: Kiazi kitamu, zao jingine la mizizi
reason.dg: Chiazi cha mtswano, mmea wanjina wa mizi
Mtele, chakurya cha kpwanza cha musingi

reason.en: A wild relative in the spurge family
reason.sw: Jamaa wa porini katika familia ya mibono
reason.dg: Ndugu wa weruni wa mbari ya euphorbia

definition.en: The cassava tuber. Unusually, the tubers share their name with the plant; Pakia notes that Digo plants often share a name with their useful part.
definition.sw: Kiazi cha muhogo. Jambo lisilo la kawaida ni kwamba viazi hivi vinashiriki jina na mmea; Pakia anabainisha kwamba mara nyingi mimea ya Kidigo hushiriki jina na sehemu yake yenye manufaa.
definition.dg: Chiazi cha manga. Si kawaida, ela viazi vina dzina sawa na mmea; Pakia anagomba kukala mimea ya Chidigo kpwa kawaida ina dzina sawa na seemu yao ya fwaida.

definition.en: A single cassava tuber. The same word names the sections of sugarcane and finger segments; Pakia thinks it is a counting word.
definition.sw: Kiazi kimoja cha muhogo. Neno hilohilo hutaja pingili za muwa na vifundo vya vidole; Pakia anadhani ni neno la kuhesabia.
definition.dg: Chiazi chimwenga cha manga. Neno hiri hiri ni dzina ra vipande vya muwa na vipande vya vyala; Pakia anaona ni neno ra kuolangira.

definition.en: Small pieces: small cassava or potato tubers.
definition.sw: Vipande vidogo: viazi vidogo vya muhogo au vya viazi.
definition.dg: Vipande vidide: viazi vidide vya manga au vya chiazi.

definition.en: The fibrous strands running through the middle of a cassava tuber.
definition.sw: Nyuzi zinazopita katikati ya kiazi cha muhogo.
definition.dg: Nyuzi zinazotsupa kahi-kahi ya chiazi cha manga.

definition.en: The lobes of the cassava leaf; Pakia uses cassava as the example of a lobed leaf.
definition.sw: Sehemu za jani la muhogo; Pakia anatumia muhogo kama mfano wa jani lenye sehemu.
definition.dg: Vyala vya kodza ra manga; Pakia anahumira manga dza mfwano wa kodza renye vyala.

definition.en: Cassava leaves eaten as a vegetable. Pakia notes that only the young leaves are eaten.
definition.sw: Majani ya muhogo yanayoliwa kama mboga. Pakia anabainisha kwamba ni majani machanga tu yanayoliwa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga manga ganagoriwa dza mtsunga. Pakia anagomba kukala ni makodza matsanga bahi ganagoriwa.

definition.en: Cassava leaves; another Mgombato word alongside mpeya.
definition.sw: Majani ya muhogo; neno jingine la Mgombato pamoja na mpeya.
definition.dg: Makodza ga manga; neno ranjina ra Mgombato phamwenga na *mpeya*.

definition.en: The small fruit of the cassava plant, which has no known use. This is the older word, given by elderly Digo.
definition.sw: Tunda dogo la mmea wa muhogo, ambalo halina matumizi yanayojulikana. Hili ndilo neno la zamani, linalotolewa na Wadigo wazee.
definition.dg: Tunda dide ra mmea wa manga, ambaro tarina kazi inayomanyikana. Hiri ni neno ra kare, rinarogombwa ni azehe a Chidigo.

definition.en: The cassava fruit, as most younger Digo call it. The pattern 'seed of …' is used for the fruits of plants nobody uses.
definition.sw: Tunda la muhogo, kama Wadigo wengi vijana wanavyoliita. Mtindo wa 'mbegu ya …' hutumika kwa matunda ya mimea ambayo hakuna anayeyatumia.
definition.dg: Tunda ra manga, dza vira Adigo anji a chizazi chiphya anavyoriiha. Mpangilio wa 'tembe ya …' nkuhumirwa kpwa matunda ga mimea isiyohumirwa ni mutu.

definition.en: Cassava peeled and dried in the sun.

use.en: Pounded into flour for jora and bada; Pakia notes drying was a way to store food against famine.
use.sw: Hutwangwa kuwa unga wa jora na bada; Pakia anabainisha kwamba kukausha ilikuwa njia ya kuhifadhi chakula kwa ajili ya njaa.
use.dg: Nkuphondwa kuhenda unga wa jora na bada; Pakia anagomba kukala kuanika kala ni njira ya kuika chakurya kpwa wakati wa ndzala.

definition.en: Cassava meal. Jora made only from makopa flour is called jora ra chipitu, 'plain jora'.
definition.sw: Unga wa muhogo. Jora linalotengenezwa kwa unga wa makopa pekee huitwa jora ra chipitu, 'jora tupu'.
definition.dg: Unga wa manga. Jora ririrohendwa kpwa unga wa makopa bahi rinaihwa *jora ra chipitu*, 'jora rihuphu'.

definition.en: A stiff porridge made from dried, ground cassava.
definition.sw: Ugali mzito unaotengenezwa kwa muhogo uliokaushwa na kusagwa.
definition.dg: Sima ngumu inayohendwa kula kpwa manga garigoumiswa na kusagwa.

mgombato: manga (-) cassava; muhogo. (See: chisamfu, gbwazo, gbwindi, jora, makopa, mpeya, mwachupa)
chisamfu cassava leaves; kisamvu (Tz). (See: manga, mpeya)
mpeya (-) cassava leaves; kisamvu (Tz). (See: chisamfu, manga)
